name: General
description: Introductions, everyday chat and anything that does not fit elsewhere
guidance: Say hello, share what you are up to and keep it friendly.

name: Help
description: Ask how something works, get unstuck and share answers
guidance: Say what you tried, what you expected and what happened instead. When something solves it, say so.

name: Showcase
description: Projects, write-ups and things you made
guidance: Share what you built and how. Screenshots, source links and lessons learned are welcome.

name: Technology
description: Software, hardware, the web and the tools we use
guidance: News, opinions and comparisons. Link to your sources and keep it civil.

name: Feedback
description: Suggestions and questions about this forum
guidance: One idea or question per thread. Say what you would like to change and why.
